title: November Classic in the New Forest
text: While a number of members were participating in the Norwich City Urban event yesterday others had travelled further afield, competing in the November Classic at Burley in the New Forest. The Burley event was an important event in the Junior calendar, being one of the selection races for the Interland team. Both Tim Harrison and Matthew Clark achieved excellent results, Tim winning the Short Brown outright and Matthew coming first in his M14 age group on the Blue course. Congratulations!
